sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE VISHAL DHAGAT  ON THE 5 th OF MAY, 2025
WRIT PETITION No. 11208 of 2025  RAMLALLU PATHAK AND OTHERS

Versus  UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri Brahmendra Prasad Pathak - Advocate for petitione  Shri Ashish Agrawal - Standing counsel for Union of In  Shri Sharad Chandra Khare, Ms. Sachi Khare & Pruthvi D  Advocate for respondent no.5/Caveator.
Shri Sparsh Prasad - Advocate for respondent.

ORDER Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India making a prayer for quashing of the entire land acquisition proceedings initiated under Right to Fair Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.

opennyai_summary.facts: ORDER Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India making a prayer for quashing of the entire land acquisition proceedings initiated under Right to Fair Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.
opennyai_summary.arguments: 2. Counsel for petitioner has raised a ground that acquisition proceedings ought to have been conducted under Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Aforesaid issue has already been dealt with by this Court in WP.No.9390/2025 vide order dated 03.04.2025.
In view of order dated 03.04.2025 passed in W.P.No.9390/2025, there is no merit in the petition.
Writ Petition is, therefore, dismissed.
Petitioner is entitled to benefits which may be granted to him in the award.
6. Petitioner is at liberty to raise other grounds which are available to him in reference.
